comparison_scope: Frozen common all-layer BE PolyFormer graph adaptations of selected source methods; no full DICE/FoRDE superiority or posterior guarantee
data_contract: Exact admitted native graph/release/official TRAIN labels and VALIDATION checkpoint selector; no candidate fit/control split or supervised removal masks are adopted here
warm_contract: One competent immutable shared warm bank per predeclared block, copied into each arm; actual source-qualified composition and warm receipt required

predictor_partition.proposed_trainable: Every existing R/S tensor at exact affine sites in the adopted all-layer composition, including lin1, lin2 and lin3 boundary factors
predictor_partition.frozen: Every common affine weight/bias, LayerNorm parameter, learned shared bias scale, buffer and statistic

forward.view: Native complete graph operator and token caches only
forward.mode: All predictor modules eval; gradient-enabled; dropout inactive; frozen maps remain live
forward.mini_batch_optimization: Select target token rows only after qualifying equality to full native forward from immutable complete graph tokens; native blocks are row-local
forward.batch_stream: Predeclared shuffled TRAIN-node permutations; visit all nodes per epoch; final batch uses actual B in all force scalings

learner_optimizer.learning_rate_and_schedule: Required immutable graph-competence-qualified configuration before adoption/execution; source image LR0.1 is a reference only
learner_optimizer.state_start: Fresh SGD velocity in every arm after copied warm parameters, pending adoption
learner_optimizer.objective_member_scale: sum of mean-per-member CE; no1/M rescaling in main source-style force
learner_optimizer.duration: Required prospective graph-qualified epoch schedule; no fixed200-attempt ceiling

dice.display_name: Frozen-common all-private DICE CR with unit instance noise, source-style SGD
dice.published_variant: Appendix F.2 deterministic/no-compression CR ablation; not full DICE
dice.feature: Native h after lin2+ReLU and before lin3; no centering/normalization/projection
dice.noise: Independent N(0,I_H); four replicas; exact bank reuse and negative partner policy in DICE_NOISE_AND_STATE.md
dice.ramp_reference: Prospective linear ramp from0 to0.1 over first80 source-style epochs; not proposal attempts; final graph schedule pending competence/adoption
dice.discriminator: Same shared class embedding64, zero-filled member slots and four-layer architecture as sealed v1
dice.discriminator_loss: Unweighted BCE-with-logits; one joint positive to two product negatives; no odds correction or full-DV product term
dice.auxiliary_optimizer: RMSProp LR0.003,alpha0.99,eps1e-8,weight_decay0,momentum0,centeredFalse,foreachFalse; four updates per completed learner cycle
dice.later_auxiliary_joint_banks: Fresh positive noises after each preceding auxiliary step; no unused post-final draw
dice.means: Current base-predictor means for target/partner IDs; detached before predictor update; no stale persistent class memory
dice.normal_cycle_exception: Stop; do not publish partial cycle or silently continue. Resume from last completed-cycle checkpoint and replay sealed stream.

forde.display_name: Frozen-common all-private FoRDE Identity with author raw-logit score, source-style SGD
forde.score: Native true-class raw logit; log-probability is a separately named variant
forde.input_domain: Entire immutable native feature matrix X with fixed native P, not token-space metric or self-node-only gradients
forde.token_coefficient: q[m,b,k,f]=d raw_logit_y(target_b)/d T_k(target_b,f), live create_graph derivative; summed selected-token VJP valid only under qualified row locality
forde.gram: G[b,k,l]=dot(row_target_b(P^k),row_target_b(P^l)); fixed graph-only cache; exact full-feature contraction
forde.normalization: q_i/sqrt(sum_kl G_kl dot(q_i,k,q_i,l)+1e-24), representing normalized full-X gradient
forde.bandwidth: h[j,b]=stopgrad(median_i D[i,j,b])/log(M)+1e-12; include self; even median averages central two sorted values
forde.kernel: K[i,j]=(1/B)*sum_b exp(-D[i,j,b]/h[j,b]); all references including self
forde.repulsion: R_sum=(1/B)*sum_i log(sum_j K[i,j]); stable logsumexp over j,b minus logB
forde.source_prior: Only ordinary coupled SGD parameter decay; no extra Gaussian-prior term or candidate coefficient

serving.primary: softmax(mean_m raw_logits_m), established project endpoint, disclosed FoRDE adaptation
serving.secondary: mean_m softmax(raw_logits_m), saved FoRDE author endpoint; evaluate same checkpoints/logits without refitting
serving.checkpoint_rule: One prospectively declared validation criterion per block, same for all arms; freeze before comparison outcomes
